my-3D2dge handoff package

v0.92.0 · dev-build. Everything a coding agent needs to build, run, test and check a game on my-3D2dge, in 2D or in real 3D, as text files. Start with README.md, then read API.md; for a game in real 3D, the 3D manual too (the header of my-3d2dge-3d.js). Play a genre kit, the 2D template game or the 3D one.

Start here

  • README.mdwhat the package holds, 2D or 3D, which page to read, how to run and test a game
  • API.mdthe API card: read it whole

Games to start from

  • kits/the 22 2D genre kits, readable (each kit's game, kits/<id>.js, and the page that plays it; node kits/test.mjs runs them headless): adventure pointclick platformer metroidvania shooter arcade pinball artillery puzzle rhythm rpg roguelike tactics rts sim brawler fighting animlab kart road sports stealth
  • kits/3d-*the 7 3D genre kits on the 3D engine, readable (kits/3d-<id>.js, and the page that plays it, served): 3d-action 3d-platformer 3d-shooter 3d-horror 3d-racing 3d-flight 3d-crawler
  • game/the 2D template game: play it; game/game.js to copy, node game/test.mjs its headless test
  • game3d/the 3D template game (the 3D manual's quick start): served, node tools/check.mjs game3d/index.html; game3d/game.js to copy

The engines

  • my-3d2dge.jsthe full 2D engine, readable: the core and every module; every 2D page here loads it, and so does every 3D page, first
  • my-3d2dge-agent.jsthe agent edition: the essential engine, its header a short manual
  • my-3d2dge-3d.jsthe 3D engine (an ES module): a three.js and Rapier world under a game; its header is the 3D manual, with a complete game
  • modules/each module on its own, loaded after the engine (its header its manual; my-3d2dge.js has them all): arcade click drive fight gen grid mode7 physics rhythm road rooms rpg songs story strategy terrain
  • vendor/three.js r182 and Rapier 0.19.3, the libraries the 3D engine loads (their licences and checksums with them)

Manuals

  • API-INDEX.mdevery public 2D name, one line each: search it (3D names: the 3D manual)
  • AI_GUIDE.mdthe guide: recipes for every genre, the look, heights, sessions: search it
  • docs/ASSETS.mdthe asset card: objects and materials as data (r.shape), the core library, writing one
  • docs/LANGUAGES.mdevery word a line: a game in the player's own language

Tools

  • tools/check.mjsplays a game in a browser (a 3D page served) and reports errors, screenshots and its snapshot
  • tools/filmstrip.mjsrecords frames into one picture
  • tools/replay.mjsreplays a recorded play session exactly
  • tools/lines.mjsa page's words: puts the engine's lines in its game-lines block, --check checks it as the AI Hub will
  • tools/lines-scan.mjsplays a page in the test language en-XA and lists words not from its lines
  • tools/asset-find.mjssearches the core library and the store: node tools/asset-find.mjs "tavern table"
  • tools/asset-sheet.mjsdraws an object in every view and says what reads badly
  • tools/asset-set.mjscuts the few entries a game uses from the store's sets (asset-lib.mjs is theirs)
  • package.jsonpins Playwright for the tools

Assets

  • src/assets/the asset store: 29 sets of objects and materials converted from CC0 libraries, and their catalogs
